Scenario fixture: rgaa-link-title-content-name (RGAA 6.1.2, 6.1.3)

Each target has a stable id of the form ltc_case_NN. A link's title must repeat at least the name its content gives it (glossary « Intitulé de lien », note 2): for a composite link, its text and the alternative of each image, in any order.

01 — FAIL: an image link whose title drops the alternative
02 — FAIL: a composite link whose title keeps its text but drops the icon's alternative
Rapport annuel
03 — PASS: an image link whose title repeats the alternative
04 — PASS: a composite link whose title holds its text and the icon's alternative in another order
Rapport annuel
05 — CANTTELL: a composite link whose title drops only a one-character alternative, which may be a symbol
Aide
